spiritgiven.comments: Thanks for your clear and calm communication throughout the confusion with the volunteers! We felt there was a varying level of rules knowledge among your team members and appreciated the input of your spirit captains in those conversations.
Great use of handsignals and calm communication but sometimes players not involved in the call tried to influence the discussion very early.

spiritreceived.comments: Thank you for the enjoyable and intense game to start the tournament. We were especially impressed with your fair-mindedness in considering outcomes that were detrimental to your team, communication (introductions and high fives on the sideline) and positivity with congratulating all plays.
Retracted calls when appropriate and their spirit captain really went out of their way to be a symbol and example of what spirit should look like.
We felt that there were moments where the team were using the rules to their advantage rather than a fair-minded outcome.

Danke schön for the amazing game! We were so looking forward to playing you, and the match didn’t disappoint. The contact avoidance was excellent, and your positivity irrespective of the scoreboard was so appreciated. The calls were resolved quickly and respectfully, and we especially liked the spirit circle before the match. Hope to see you again soon for a rematch!
We appreciate your perseverance on the field and would like to reiterate the importance of the knowledge of the rules. Thank you!

Deutschland, thank you so much for another really well-spirited game. It was a tough match with challenging conditions, and we were so impressed with how positive and calm your team remained despite the closeness of the scoreboard. Jawoll <3
